label: Filippino Lippi
summary: Florentine painter whose commissions intersected with Leonardo's (San Donato a Scopeto, Santissima Annunziata); present at the David committee of January 1504.

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Died in Florence in April 1504 (18 or 20 April).

value.text: Adoration for San Donato a Scopeto, 1496

claims.statement: His Adoration of the Magi (Uffizi), dated 1496, was painted for San Donato a Scopeto, the convent whose 1481 commission Leonardo left unfinished.

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

value.text: Withdrew from the Annunziata altarpiece in Leonardo's favour

claims.statement: Vasari says Filippino gave up the high altarpiece of Santissima Annunziata when Leonardo expressed interest (1500). This is Vasari's statement.
